name: Perfect Incision
description: Draw a single perfect edge across the target in one stroke that parts the guard along its grain.

name: Perfect Ward
description: Hold a ward of perfect crystal whose faces give every blow an equal share to bear.

name: Perfect Lance
description: Throw one lance of unflawed crystal that passes through guard and armour as through air.

name: Perfect Mending
description: Grow flawless crystal into deep wounds on several allies and set the flesh back to its true form.

name: Crystal Absolute
description: Raise an unbroken crystal across the field that holds every foe in place and cuts as it grows.

name: Facet Infinite
description: Cut endless facets in the air so that beams of crystal light pass through every foe in sight.

name: Symmetry Absolute
description: Meet any force with a perfect mirror of itself and return the whole of it to its source.

name: Clarity Total
description: Make the field as clear as flawless glass so the user and allies see every body and every blow in it.

name: Prism Eternal
description: Raise a prism that never dims and loose it as beams that pierce the foes with a force scaling to the reserve.

name: Lattice Eternal
description: Set a lattice that does not fail and let it hold the foes and shelter the user with strength scaling to the reserve.

name: Lattice Cataclysm
description: Set a perfect lattice through the whole region and break it at once to the destructive ceiling of a crystal master of this tier.

name: Reality Crystallized
description: Turn the field itself into one flawless crystal that holds all within still with no force or medium any cultivation mechanic can name.
